incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty - P1: GPU memory pressure detected on serving-runtime-prod (node:gk-12). Alert rule: gpu.memory.available < 1.5GB for 90s. PD incident: PD-4872.

pagerduty: Triggered incident PD-4872. Assigned to: Samir (oncall). Escalation policy: infra-oncall -> sre-leads.

Samir (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. First check: are we seeing customer errors or just infra OOMs?

Priya (infra): Looking at node gk-12 now. dmesg shows CUDA OOM on process 21437 (redwood-inference-worker). GPU memory at 98% across 2 GPUs. Pod list in inference namespace attached.

Jenny (ml-runtime): Noted. Recent deploy? Any model rollouts? I don't see new deployments in the last 2 hours. Sequence lengths spiked ~10m ago on route /v1/chat/stream for model rdx-large-quant.

Samir (oncall): Copy. Priya - can you run `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep worker` and `kubectl describe pod <pod>` for the failing pod? I'm going to check SLOs and customer error rate.

Priya (infra): Paste: ```
$ kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep worker
redwood-inference-worker-7f6bd8b5c-2lq5  1/1 Running  0  3d   10.128.7.45  gk-12
redwood-inference-worker-7f6bd8b5c-xt9r  1/1 CrashLoopBackOff  5  12m  10.128.9.12  gk-12
```
Describing xt9r shows OOMKilled on container `inference` with message: `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` and kernel log `out of memory allocating 2147483648 bytes`.

ops-bot: Auto-scaling suggestion: cluster autoscaler has capacity 0 for GPU family; current nodepool at max size 6. Recommend temporary scale-up if load persists.

Samir (oncall): Jenny / Priya - can we mitigate without scaling? Potential quick fixes: evict the crashing pod, restart worker on different node, or force model fallback to smaller variant. What's cheapest risk-wise?

Jenny (ml-runtime): Two quick mitigations: 1) apply model fallback policy to route /v1/chat/stream -> rdx-medium instead of rdx-large-quant. That reduces memory significantly. 2) Restart the worker pod to clear KV cache. Both low-risk; fallback first, restart second. I'll prepare the rollout.

Priya (infra): I'm going to cordon gk-12 to avoid scheduling more pods there: `kubectl cordon gk-12`. Then evict the CrashLoopBackOff pod: `kubectl delete pod redwood-inference-worker-7f6bd8b5c-xt9r -n inference`.

Alex (sre): FYI, loadbalancer NEGs show increased queue times for a subset of requests. Customer error rate for `inference` 5xx spiked from 0.3% -> 4.1% last 15m. Affected tenants: 3 customer orgs with long-sequence generation. Customer-success-bot pinged owners.

Samir (oncall): Jenny, proceed with fallback. Priya, proceed with cordon/delete. I'll monitor PD incident and SLOs. If fallback doesn't reduce memory pressure in 5m, we escalate to add nodes.

Jenny (ml-runtime): Applying fallback: `redwoodctl routes update --route /v1/chat/stream --model rdx-medium --force` -> rolling config applied. Confirmed streams now landing on rdx-medium for new requests.

Priya (infra): Pod xt9r evicted and restarted on gk-8: `redwood-inference-worker-7f6bd8b5c-9vtr` Running. GPU memory on gk-12 dropping as processes exit. No new OOMs in the last 60s.

ops-bot: Autoscaler note: nodepool still at max. No scale-up attempted.

Alex (sre): 5xx rate falling back toward baseline: 4.1% -> 1.2% over last 3m. Latency on long seqs increased ~30% because of fallback, but still within SLO for gold customers.

Samir (oncall): Good. Marking incident progress: mitigation applied (fallback + pod restart). Monitoring for stabilization for 15m. Starting timeline note for postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident PD-4872 auto-escalation timer set to 15m. Next update at 1762008785 if not resolved.

Jenny (ml-runtime): Quick log snippet from restarted worker showing runtime allocation failures before restart: ```
[2026-02-10T14:12:03Z] ERROR inference: failed to allocate kv cache chunk size=536870912; CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
[2026-02-10T14:12:05Z] WARN  inference: falling back to CPU for chunk processing
``` Suggest we add guard to refuse >max_seq 4096 on rdx-large-quant or improve kv cache eviction.

Priya (infra): Checking other nodes for memory fragmentation. gk-9 has 2 free GPUs with 10GB each. No further OOMs.

Samir (oncall): Can we confirm customer impact list and notify CS? Alex / customer-success-bot - who to notify and what message?

customer-success-bot: Notified account owners for tenants A123, B456, C789. Suggested message: short explanation + ETA. Draft: "We saw transient GPU memory pressure affecting some long-sequence requests; we've applied a temporary fallback to a smaller model while we investigate. No data was exposed; requests are being served with slightly higher latency. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline."

Alex (sre): Sending that now. Also creating a Grafana snapshot for the incident: link: https://grafana.company/s/abc123

Samir (oncall): After 12m stabilization, 5xx rate back to 0.4% and no new OOMs. I'm going to resolve the PD incident if things stay stable for another 10m. Assigning follow-ups: Jenny to own runtime guard and patch, Priya to validate nodepool scaling limits, Alex to produce mem/kv usage dashboard.

Jenny (ml-runtime): I'll open a PR for max_seq guard + reduce initial kv cache prefetch. ETA EOD.

Priya (infra): I'll request temporary bump of nodepool max from 6 -> 9 as precaution for auto-scaling.

Samir (oncall): PD incident PD-4872: marking as acknowledged -> monitoring. Will resolve after 10m stable. Good work everyone :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PD-4872 status updated: acknowledged -> monitoring.

[1762008345] Samir (oncall): Update: stable for 10m, no regressions. Closing incident PD-4872. Postmortem ticket created: PM-311.

Jenny (ml-runtime): Thanks. Will include indicators and a reproducible test for high sequence injections in PM-311.

Priya (infra): I'll follow up on nodepool and autoscaler policy in PM-311.

Alex (sre): Adding timeline and Grafana snapshots to the postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident PD-4872 closed at 1762008345.

Samir (oncall): Handoff note: I'll be offshift in 30m; Alex will take overnight watch. Leaving incident notes in PM-311.

Jenny (ml-runtime): :memo: Action items: runtime guard PR, add unit test for kv-cache, alert tuning to use memory delta instead of absolute threshold.

Priya (infra): :white_check_mark: Action items: nodepool bump request, check autoscaler behaviour, add node isolation runbook for GPU OOM.

Alex (sre): :eyes: I'll do a quick runbook update and make sure CS templates are ready.

Samir (oncall): Thanks all. Closing thread.
